meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Compared the inherited ready-model selection, strict assistant tool-call response and Luna reasoning setting with the runtime and observability guides.

auth.review_note: Verified the authored header controls remain on the existing owner admin GET and CSRF-guarded POST, with published-only guest content. The backend guidance retains the existing role and account isolation described in authentication docs.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed the authored-page data section added to the backend skill alongside catalogue, orders and tax references. The new optional settings fields and upload row lock apply to authored headers, leaving the documented commerce record and payment flows intact.

content.review_note: Compared the published search and Blog module guidance with the merged templates. The authored view keeps the released document structure and renders the same image and Markdown during preview and after publication.

foundation.review_note: Compared the fixed audit projection and PHP cutoff with the storage guide. Authored page validation and media locks use their existing direct and authenticated bridge paths.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed the merged Integrations provider guidance alongside the existing Google reporting controls and public head layout.

http-errors.review_note: Compared the admin heading selection and authored page validation with canonical error rendering. Header eligibility failures remain expected owner form feedback, and transport and handler failures retain sanitized status and correlation behavior.

interface.review_note: Reviewed the dashboard values and unavailable state against the admin guide and checked the authored header picker and preview against Design.

mail.review_note: Checked the merged AdminController dashboard and authored page paths against the mail guide. Existing queue and delivery actions retain their documented behavior.

mcp-clients.review_note: Checked the merged Integrations guide against the local MCP client controller and form. The owner issues and revokes a paid-sales grant, and the trusted STDIO client receives it through its process environment.

media.review_note: Checked the combined admin skill against guarded Media Library deletion and the authored header attach lock. The public renderer reads only the selected owned image URL.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the 30-day storefront counters and unavailable status with the Reports guide. The authored Pages guide still matches the owner header picker and preview.

public-mcp.review_note: Cross-checked the dashboard and authored page map entries against Public MCP and A2UI. The owner audit projection uses the authenticated database bridge.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed the fixed, read-only dashboard projection alongside Checkout and authored header locking. The existing cart and checkout paths retain their documented inputs and actions.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the regenerated route inventory and CI. MySQL and MariaDB jobs cover storefront reads while existing checks cover authored pages.
